prior_information: Pooled Quanta primary result already inspected; this secondary specification is exploratory, not an untouched preregistration. Task/trial inclusion and common baseline reuse were fixed earlier in native_oos_followthrough_jobs.json.

inference.multiplicity: Holm over all54 opening-information unit/baseline contrasts when both cases complete; conservative54*p Bonferroni upper bound when one case complete. Native execution is diagnostic. Secondary tests never promote or replace a primary contrast.

completeness: Every prespecified task/trial required. Failed source rounds remain; no success-only filtering. Zero usable programs or a failed evaluation leaves a declared incomplete case; no fabricated portfolio.
baseline_reuse: Use byte-identical complete-primary baseline accounts once per case/execution, explicitly reference them for every unit. Validate each subset against the complete parent library and its exact source-used program set.
interpretation: Conditional on fixed libraries and one shared market history per case. Model trials and evolution tasks are not independent market histories. Pointwise intervals assume approximately independent normal time-block means; calibration is not a universal guarantee. No JKP132 attribution or pristine confirmatory/full-paper claim.
reporting: All unit contrasts plus descriptive distributions. Do not rank/select/promote a unit on evaluation returns. Full-sample mean and grouped mean are distinct; annualized geometric returns are not calendar-time CAGR.
